Overview

In 2026, Charles repeatedly called for the U.S. Marshals and U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents to be present at Maine polling locations ahead of the 2026 election, despite federal restrictions on armed federal officers near polls. His calls aligned with Trump’s push for greater federal involvement in the 2026 elections and as Trump declined to rule out sending federal agents to the polls.

In February, Charles described the presence of U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents as a “deterrent” to undocumented immigrants he accused of being used to “tip the balance” in elections. By June, Charles again said he would call Tom Homan to send federal agents to Maine and warned the state would not tolerate election “irregularities.” 

In August, Charles repeated the proposal at a Maine Young Republicans event in Arundel, saying he would ask his “friend” Tom Homan to send U.S. Marshals and U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents to the polls weeks before Election Day. Arundel directly borders Biddeford, where a U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent fatally shot Joan Sebastián Durán Guerrero in July during an enforcement operation that did not target him. Charles responded by calling for Congress to provide U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement with additional resources.

Charles’ calls for federal agents at Maine polling locations were not the first time he promoted claims of election fraud in Maine. In 2025, Bobby Charles promoted election fraud claims, accused Democrats and immigrants of undermining Maine’s voting system, and encouraged voters to support Question 1, which would have imposed voter ID and absentee voting restrictions. Charles claimed that Maine elections were “corrupt” and pushed voter ID and absentee voting restrictions, despite Maine voters later rejecting Question 1 by a more than 25-point margin in 2025.

July 2026: After A Federal Immigration Agent Fatally Shot Joan Sebastián Durán Guerrero In Biddeford, Charles Called For Congress To Provide U.S. Immigration And Customs Enforcement Agents With Additional Resources

July 2026: Joan Sebastian Durán Guerrero Was Fatally Shot By A Federal Immigration Agent In Biddeford During An Enforcement Operation He Was Not The Target Of. According to CNN, "A simple memorial of flowers and candles has gone up near the spot on a Maine street where Joan Sebastian Durán Guerrero’s partner fell to her knees and his 3-year-old daughter cried after he was fatally shot by an ICE officer on Monday. Durán Guerrero, a 25-year-old food delivery driver from Colombia, died Monday in the historic Atlantic coast city of Biddeford, where neighbors remembered him as a good man and hard worker. The Colombian Embassy initially reported his age as 26. [...] An ICE officer fired his weapon ‘fearing for public safety’ as Durán Guerrero, in a vehicle, ‘attempted to flee the scene,’ the Department of Homeland Security said in its first official statement nearly 12 hours after the shooting. He was not the target of the enforcement operation." [CNN, 7/15/26]

In 2026, Trump Suggested He Was Open To Declaring A National Emergency And Deploying Federal Troops To Assert More Control Over The 2026 Elections, And Called For Republicans To Nationalize Elections

August 11, 2026: Trump Declined To Rule Out Declaring A National Emergency As A Way To Assert More Control Over The 2026 Elections, Suggesting The Option Was In Play. According to CNN, "President Donald Trump in a new interview declined to rule out declaring a national security emergency as a means to try to assert more control over the 2026 midterm elections. It’s merely the latest warning sign that Trump could try to mess with the election not just by baselessly claiming voter fraud and challenging the results afterward — as he did in 2020, leading to a violent riot at the US Capitol — but by trying to unilaterally take control before votes are cast. In the interview, Wayne Allyn Root of Real America’s Voice pitched such a scenario to Trump. He suggested it as an alternative, given the Senate has failed to pass Trump’s coveted elections bill, known as the ‘SAVE America Act.’ ‘If they never get the SAVE America Act done, you have the right to declare a national security emergency for elections,’ Root said. He added that ‘if you declare a national security emergency as the president of the United States, they can’t challenge it. It can only be overturned by a two-thirds vote by both houses of Congress. So if you do this in the next month, we will get photo ID, proof of citizenship (for voter registration) and a limit to mail-in ballots.’ It’s at this point that Trump cut Root off and coyly suggested such an option was indeed in play. ‘Let me just say that stranger things have happened, OK?’ Trump said. ‘I’ll leave it at that.’" [CNN, 8/11/26]

May 2026: Trump Declined To Rule Out Deploying Federal Troops Or Agents To The Polls During The 2026 Elections, Saying He Would “Do Anything Necessary To Make Sure We Have Honest Elections.” According to Democracy Docket, "President Donald Trump won’t rule out deploying troops or federal agents to the polls during the upcoming midterm elections, he said in comments to journalists Tuesday. ‘I’d do anything necessary to make sure we have honest elections,’ Trump said. ‘We have to have honest elections.’ His comments came in response to PBS Newshour correspondent Liz Landers, who asked whether the president would send the National Guard or Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents to voting locations this November." [Democracy Docket, 5/12/26]

February 2026: Trump Urged The Republican Party To “Take Over The Voting In At Least 15 Places" And To Nationalize Elections. October 2025: Bobby Charles Claimed Widespread Ballot Fraud And Claimed Maine Elections Were “Corrupt” While Urging New Voting Restrictions. According to Charles’ Twitter thread, “If you need ID to buy a beer, drive a car, or get on a plane, you sure as hell should need it to choose your leaders. But Augusta Democrats are losing their minds over this. They’re calling voter ID ‘an attack on democracy.’  Actually, ballot fraud is the attack on democracy.  Here’s what Question 1 actually does:  -Requires voter ID for both in-person and absentee ballots. -Ends the endless ‘automatic absentee’ loophole. -Limits unsecured drop boxes. -Bans phone-in ballot requests. This is common sense. Augusta Democrats want to keep ballots flying around Maine like junk mail, no oversight, no verification, no accountability. That’s how we end up with ‘lost ballots’ showing up in Amazon boxes. Under this corrupt system, Augusta Democrats protect the same chaos that benefits illegal aliens, out-of-state operatives, and ballot harvesters, not law-abiding Mainers. When I served as a Naval Intelligence Officer, I tracked and dismantled drug cartels.  You learn fast: the moment you stop verifying identities, corruption floods in. It’s no different in elections.  Maine deserves elections we can trust. Democrats call that ‘extreme.’ I call it basic security, for your vote, your town, and your future. Send a message to the corrupt Democrat Machine in Augusta:  ✅ VOTE YES ON 1 for voter ID ❌ VOTE NO ON 2 to protect our Constitution.”

[Twitter, @Bobby4Maine, 10/10/25]

Voters Rejected Question 1 By More Than 25 Points As Returns Showed Broad Statewide Opposition

November 2025: Maine Voters Overwhelmingly Rejected Question 1’s Voter ID And Absentee Voting Restrictions. According to Maine Public, “Maine voters resoundingly defeated a ballot initiative on Tuesday that would have required them to show a photo ID during future elections and that sought to rollback aspects of the state’s absentee voting process.  The Associated Press called the race less than two hours after polls closed as early returns showed strong opposition to Question 1 in more left-leaning coastal areas but also in pockets of rural Maine. That voting gap widened as results trickled in. And by midnight, Question 1 was failing 36.1% to 63.9% with roughly three-quarters of votes counted, according to the AP.” [Maine Public, 11/4/25]
